exposure: Neonates with HIE vs. neonates without HIE
cohort: 164 neonates with HIE and 656 neonates without HIE
finding: Neonates with HIE were more likely to have been a planned home birth compared with neonates without HIE, even after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Neonates with hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) were more likely to have been planned home births compared to those without HIE, even after adjusting for confounders including mode of birth.
